facts.claim: Hanyangdoseong was originally built in 1396 and extends 18.6 km around the historic capital, following Bugaksan,Naksan,Namsan and Inwangsan.
facts.evidence: The wall stretches for 18.6km along the ranges of Bugaksan Mountain, Naksan Mountain, Namsan Mountain, and Inwangsan Mountain.
